item.text: {"case_id":"SHC028","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C11","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C18 plausibly supplied a material foundation for the later report because it establishes the specific Iran-United States Claims Tribunal machinery that dominates the child: suspension and presentation of claims to the Tribunal, jurisdictional determinations, merits awards, payment-based discharge, Treasury implementation, and congressional transmission. The child then reports concrete developments under that same machinery, including adjudications, jurisdictional dismissals, awards, settlements, and government-to-government claims. C11 is a weaker source for the child's discussion of the Bank of England escrow account and Iranian bank claims, while C17 supplies broader Iran-emergency and Treasury-accounting context but not the report's principal structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Iran-United States Claims Tribunal, established at The Hague pursuant to the Claims Settlement Agreement of January 19, 1981, continues to make some progress in arbitrating the 3,848 claims","parent_excerpt":"All claims which may be presented to the Iran-United States Claims Tribunal under the terms of Article II of the Declaration ...
